meta.title: Lease Loop – catalogue
meta.description: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine. When the lease ends, it gets a second life.
brand.name: Lease Loop
brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines
catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.intro: Every item can be leased, returned, refurbished and leased again.

dealer.title: Returns
dealer.intro: Follow each returned item from request to refurbishment plan.
dealer.wishlistIntro: Customers waiting for leased items to become available again.
dealer.list.caption: Return requests
dealer.list.empty: No return requests yet. A request appears here when a customer asks to return a leased item.
dealer.detail.noAction: There is nothing more to do here for now.
dealer.timeline.title: Progress

dealer.receive.help: Only confirm when the equipment is physically here. You record its condition in the next step.

dealer.inspect.help: Record the condition and usage you find. These numbers decide the refurbishment cost.
dealer.inspect.serviceHistory: Usage since the last service (engine hours)
dealer.inspect.serviceHistoryHelp: Required for farm machines. The service cost depends on it.

dealer.plan.result.title: Refurbishment plan
dealer.plan.result.usageReset: This work resets the usage counter.
dealer.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
dealer.error.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
dealer.error.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please check the values you entered.
dealer.error.RETURN_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND: This return request no longer exists.
dealer.error.RETURN_NOT_RECEIVED: Receive the item before inspecting it.
dealer.error.MISSING_SERVICE_HISTORY: Enter the usage since the last service for this farm machine.
dealer.error.RETURN_NOT_INSPECTED: Inspect the item before creating a plan.
dealer.error.INSPECTION_INCOMPLETE: The inspection is incomplete. Save it again.
dealer.error.INVALID_TARGET_CONDITION: The target cannot be worse than the inspected condition.
dealer.error.MISSING_REFURBISHMENT_COST_: A refurbishment cost is missing for this item. Ask the team to check the cost data.
dealer.approve.help: Approve the plan if you accept the work and its cost. Nothing changes on the item yet.
dealer.complete.help: Confirm the work is done. The item gets the planned condition and usage and goes back to the catalogue.
dealer.done.message: Refurbishment is complete. The item has its new condition and is ready for the next lease.
dealer.error.RETURN_NOT_PLANNED: Create a refurbishment plan before approving it.
dealer.error.RETURN_NOT_APPROVED: Approve the plan before completing the work.
dealer.error.PLAN_MISSING: This return has no refurbishment plan.
dealer.error.ASSET_NOT_RETURNED: The item is not in a state where the work can be completed.
dealer.error.ASSET_CHANGED: The item changed while you were working. Reload the page and try again.
dealer.error.ASSET_NOT_ON_ACTIVE_LEASE: The item is not on an active lease, so it cannot be inspected as returned.
dealer.error.CONTRACT_NOT_ACTIVE: The contract for this return is no longer active.
